title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 10.8 Vectors: View vectors geometrically.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 10.8 Vectors: View vectors geometrically.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "10.8 Vectors", prints these objectives: "View vectors geometrically." "Find magnitude and direction." "Perform vector addition and scalar multiplication." "Find the component form of a vector." "Find the unit vector in the direction of v ." "Perform operations with vectors in terms of i and j .". The section text says: "An airplane is flying at an airspeed of 200 miles per hour headed on a SE bearing of 140°. A north wind (from north to south) is blowing at 16.2 miles per hour, as shown in Figure 1 . What are the ground speed and actual bearing of the plane?" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
